subject: Alex Rivera — offer mix clarification and urgent ask
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Update: Alex Rivera has a competing offer — details and ask

Team,

Quick update from the call with Alex this morning — he received a competing offer from a stealth startup and they moved faster than us. He is excited about Redwood, specifically the infra challenges in the model-serving team, but the competing offer is materially different in the cash component.

Key facts:
- Competing offer: $225k base, $50k sign-on, 12k RSU grant (4y)
- Redwood offer on paper: $210k base, $30k sign-on, 10k RSU grant (4y)
- Candidate preference: prefers higher base + larger up-front sign-on over long-term equity if we can’t materially change both.
- Decision timeline: asks for final answer by EOD Tuesday (2026-12-22 PST) — he needs time for family/legal review.

He asked whether we can (a) increase base to $220k or (b) keep base and bump sign-on to $45k, or (c) make a one-time accelerated vesting schedule for the first-year RSUs to feel more immediate. He also called out relocation flexibility (remote ok).

Ask: can we get budget/approval to modify mix? Jonas — do you have flexibility to re-allocate budget from hiring pool? Vivek/Marissa — want to loop you for comp approval and any note for the offer letter language (accelerated cliff / sign-on structure).

Irene, adding you for awareness and for owner of the thread in case we need a rapid external conversation.

Next step: if we can agree on a preferred mix today, I’ll prepare an updated offer and get Vivek’s formal approval before sending.

Thanks,

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter, Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Update: Alex Rivera has a competing offer — details and ask

Thanks for the heads up, Monica.

High level: Alex is a strong add for the serving runtime team; his hiring profile maps to a Sr. Staff / low-end Principal scope. I prefer moving against his base if possible (option a) — we get more retention bang for base increases in his band. If legal/comp constraints make base inflexible, option b (bump sign-on to $45k) is acceptable.

On the accelerated vesting: I like the idea of 25% vesting at 6 months for the first tranche if that helps him feel immediate impact; that would be a one-off and disclosed in the offer. Does that create compliance complexity?

Budget note: I can reallocate up to $12k from my discretionary hiring padding, which gets us close to $222k base if we push. If comp team can approve a sign-on bump instead, that might be the faster path.

Irene — can you help coordinate timing with candidate if we go to sign-on bump?

-Jonas

Jonas Weber
Director, Model Serving
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T12:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer follow-up

Monica — appreciate the call this morning. Quick note so it’s captured in writing (paste of the competing offer below):

They’ve put an aggressive cash-forward package in front of me to try to close quickly. I like Redwood’s mission and the tech, but my partner prefers more cash-first in the short term. If Redwood can meet me halfway on base or sign-on I’ll be happy to accept.

Competing offer snapshot (shared by recruiter):
- Base: $225,000
- Sign-on: $50,000 (paid in first paycheck)
- RSUs: 12,000 (4 years)
- Start window: flexible, wants decision by 12/22

I’d prefer to keep the conversation focused on base/sign-on. Accelerated vesting helps but won’t replace needed cash.

Thanks — I’m reachable by phone if helpful.

—Alex
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T08:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Update: Alex Rivera has a competing offer — details and ask

Team — reviewed. Summary of what I can approve today based on band and headcount:

1) Base increase: up to $220k (we do not have budget authority to go to $225k at this level without exec sign-off).
2) Sign-on: up to $45k one-time (we can structure as two payments: $25k on hire, $20k after 6 months to aid retention).
3) Equity: 10k RSUs stands; we can add an accelerated 6-month vesting of 25% on the first tranche as a one-time adjustment (doc note required).

Please note: if we go with $220k + $45k sign-on we should mark as an "exception" in the comp notes and attach an approval memo (I’ll draft). Also confirm whether the hiring manager can cover the incremental cash against his hiring budget as Jonas noted.

Monica — if you send the exact suggested pay mix, I’ll attach the approval memo (comp-approval-note.pdf) and sign off so legal can issue the updated offer letter. Try to get this to the candidate by EOD Monday to give them reasonable time.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Compensation & Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: Updated offer — Redwood Inference (Sr. Engineer)
Attachments: updated-offer-20261220.pdf (Offer PDF), comp-approval-note.pdf (internal approval)

Alex — thanks again for your patience. Per our conversation and internal approvals, attached is an updated offer package. Summary of changes from the original: 

- Base salary: $220,000 (annual)
- Sign-on: $45,000 (one-time; $25k paid on first payroll, $20k at 6 months)
- RSUs: 10,000 over 4 years; one-time accelerated vesting: 25% of the first tranche vesting at 6 months
- Start date: flexible within Q1 2027; relocation/remote confirmed as discussed

Vivek has attached the internal approval memo and legal will issue an updated offer letter with the one-off accelerated vesting language. Please review the attached PDF and let me know by EOD Tuesday 12/22 if you’d like to accept — we’ll send DocuSign after you confirm verbally. If you need any changes to the payment timing, flag it and I will escalate.

If you’re ready to accept now, a quick reply is fine and we’ll follow with the signed DocuSign. If you want a 15-minute call to walk through the breakdown, I’m free tomorrow morning.

Best,

Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter, Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
